claims.claim: The currency is the US dollar

sources.says: Last edited 12 November 2026. The balboa is "tied to the United States dollar (which is also legal tender in Panama)" at 1:1; "U.S. banknotes are legal tender in Panama as the main form of cash in the country."

claims.claim: US estate tax applies to the worldwide estate above the $15M exemption (2026)

sources.name: IRS: What's new, estate and gift tax
sources.says: The table "Basic exclusion amount for year of death" has the row 2026: $15,000,000 (2025: $13,990,000). The page says the Working Families Tax Cuts, Public Law 119-21, signed July 4, 2025, "amends § 2010(c)(3) by increasing the basic exclusion amount to $15,000,000 for calendar year 2026". Page last reviewed or updated 03-Nov-2026.

sources.name: IRS: Estate tax
sources.says: A return is required when the gross estate, plus adjusted taxable gifts and specific exemption, is more than the filing threshold for the year of death; the table gives 2026: $15,000,000. Page last reviewed or updated 23-Oct-2026.

sources.name: IRS news release IR-2025-103: tax inflation adjustments for tax year 2026
sources.says: "Estates of decedents who die during 2026 have a basic exclusion amount of $15,000,000", up from $13,990,000 for 2025; the release (October 9, 2025) cites Revenue Procedure 2025-32 and is marked as an archival document.

sources.name: IRS: Some nonresidents with U.S. assets must file estate tax returns
sources.says: "U.S. citizens are subject to U.S. estate taxation with respect to their worldwide assets"; Form 706 is required when worldwide assets plus adjusted taxable gifts exceed the basic exclusion amount in effect on the date of death. By contrast a nonresident who is not a citizen files when US-situated assets exceed $60,000. Page last reviewed or updated 27-Jun-2026.

sources.says: Undated (©2026). Clinica Hospital San Fernando is "one of Panama's most recommended private clinics" with "a lab, ICU, radiology, and even a maternity ward on site", an extension of its Panama City location; Coronado is "a 1.5-hour drive away from Panama City".

sources.name: Reside Panama: Healthcare in Panama, hospitals, insurance and costs 2026
sources.says: Published May 28, 2026. Punta Pacífica "maintains an international affiliation with Johns Hopkins Medicine"; Pacífica Salud (Costa del Este), Hospital Nacional and Paitilla are named private hospitals; physicians "often trained internationally, many of whom speak fluent English" (it does not say US-trained). Near Boquete, residents "rely on private hospitals in David, particularly Hospital Chiriquí and Hospital Mae Lewis". Premiums: "Solo expat in their 60s+: USD 350–700+" a month. The CSS "provides care to Panamanian workers and legal residents who contribute through payroll taxes". General GP visits USD 40–80; no Boquete prices.

claims.claim: Volcán's hospital (opened 2014) is a basic emergency facility; more care is in Concepción, about 30 minutes away, and David's private hospitals are 40 minutes to an hour away (secondary source, 2018)

sources.name: International Living: Volcán, Panama
sources.says: Updated Oct 12, 2018. "A new hospital opened in Volcán in 2014, serving as a basic emergency care facility"; "Concepcion is only 30 minutes away"; David is "a quick 40-minute drive from Volcán".
